title: 第284章 天狼使者欺藩主，木堡王庭起事端
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“呛啷！”莫敦腰间弯刀出鞘！

“莫敦！把刀收回去！”乞颜部头人霍然起身，手臂一横，截在莫敦与陈醉之间。

陈醉背着手，眉毛不动半分，掀了掀眼皮，和缓道：

“莫敦头人因何动怒？陈某不过是给国主讲个乡野里养犬不驯的故事。陈某说的是室韦的恶犬，头人这般气急败坏，莫不是将自己承入了？”

莫敦被噎得正要张口怒骂。

陈醉根本不给他出声的空当，半个身子转向王座，朗声道：

“诸位头人不觉得这故事蹊跷么？这看家护院的畜生，哪有天生这般吃里扒外的？依陈某看，这内里只有一桩缘由。”

陈醉视线瞥过莫敦：“必是那打它骂它的外头恶人，私下里给这条犬扔了块肥肉。许诺它，往后只要将自家的牛羊都叼过来，这整个院子里的吃食，便全由它一头畜生独吞！”

“你血口喷人！”莫敦破口叱道。

此言一出，其他部族的亲随辅将们，交头接耳的低语声愈发不受顾忌。

“我就说！贡单这事，就数他札达部跳得最高！”

“天狼人要五千匹马，他竟说天狼人失马一万匹，让咱们还五千不多。”

“他们札达部又不挨着平津，他又不用找马，这个吃里扒外的，早把咱们卖了。”

“阿勒坦允了他什么天大的好处？莫不是要扶他做国主？”

这些压不住的声响传入耳中，一直未出过声音的黑林部头人，终是缓缓直起了身板。

他双眸阴幽幽地盯住了莫敦：

“莫敦，他们说的，可是真的？你背着大伙，到底同天狼人结了什么契？”

莫敦面皮抽搐：“一派胡言！我这般力排众议顺应天狼，全是为了保全室韦的国脉！不惹怒阿勒坦，咱们才有活路！”

乞颜部头人冷嗤出声：“放你娘的屁！你保的是你札达部做买卖的商道，割的却是我乞颜的战马，抽的是达鲁部和黑林部弟兄的血！你当大伙都是瞎子不成？”

“都给本使闭嘴！”

忽都一声暴喝，大步逼进殿中央。

“一群在林子里掏树洞的野人！也配非议大汗的赏罚？！”

忽都皮靴重重踏在地板上，嚣张道：

“不怕告诉你们！今日不管莫敦头人拿没拿大汗的好处，贡单上的物品，少一根汗毛都不行！”

满殿的室韦官员被这番狂悖之言震得一时无声。

忽都陡然转向陈醉，狞笑道：

“还有你这南朝来的细作！我方才在宫门外看到了，你手下的狗腿子竟敢骑着特穆尔王子的坐骑来招摇！在本使面前耍伶牙俐齿的手段，你今日当真是活到头了！”

忽都迈步逼近王阶，仰头冲着蒙兀喝令：

“蒙兀国主！诸位头人！殿外宁朝护卫胯下所骑之马，便是特穆尔王子走失的雪里青！这帮南朝贼子盗取天狼战马，罪不容诛！特穆尔王子正欲拿他们剥皮抽筋！”

忽都指着陈醉的鼻尖：“你们现下立刻遣人，将此人连同殿外的宁军，全数扒了甲胄捆绑起来！本使要将他们并着三王子的爱马，连同岁贡，一并押回草原，向大汗复命！”

蒙兀双手按在扶手上：“忽都使者，天狼与宁朝这百年的兵戈纠葛，我室韦向来是从不插手的。

这位陈先生，乃是云州周千户帐下的幕僚。他此番至额尔木城，是带了些中原物产来与我等谈些生意罢了，绝无兵防上的干系。使者这般要拿人，室韦确实不便依从。”

Page (1/3)

"Ouch!" Mo Dun unsheathed the scimitar at his waist!

"Mo Dun! Put the knife back!" The leader of the Qiyan tribe stood up suddenly, crossing his arms and blocking him between Mo Dun and Chen Zui.

Chen Zui put his hands behind his back, raised his eyelids without moving his eyebrows, and said gently:

"Why is Mo Duntou angry? Chen is just telling the king a story about untamed dogs in the countryside. What Chen is talking about is Shi Wei's vicious dog. If the leader is so angry, is he taking it in?"

Mo Dun was choked and was about to curse.

Chen Zui didn't give him any time to speak. He turned half of his body towards the throne and said loudly:

"Don't you, the leaders, think this story is strange? How can the beast who looks after the home and the courtyard be born to eat the inside and outside like this? According to Chen, there is only one reason for this."

Chen Zui glanced at Mo Dun: "It must be the evil person outside who beat it and scolded it. He secretly threw a piece of fat to this dog. He promised it that as long as he brings his own cattle and sheep in his mouth, he will eat all the food in the whole yard by himself!"

"You are slanderous!" Mo Dun yelled.

As soon as these words came out, the accompanying auxiliary generals from other tribes began to whisper to each other without scruple.

"I'm telling you! When it comes to Gongdan, it's Zada who can dance the highest!"

"The Sirius wanted five thousand horses, but he actually said that the Sirius lost ten thousand horses and asked us to pay back five thousand."

"The Zada tribe is not next to Pingjin, and he doesn't need to find horses. This man who eats everything has sold us long ago."

"What huge benefit did Al admit to him? Could it be that he wanted to help him become the leader of the country?"

These overwhelming sounds reached his ears, and the leader of the Black Forest tribe, who had never made a sound, finally straightened up slowly.

He stared at Mo Dun with dark eyes:

"Mo Dun, what they said is true? What kind of contract did you have with the werewolves behind your back?"

Mo Dun's face twitched: "That's nonsense! I am so willing to go against everyone's opinions and comply with Sirius, just to preserve Shi Wei's national line! Only by not angering Altan can we survive!"

The leader of the Qiyan tribe sneered coldly: "Fuck you! What you are protecting is your Zanda tribe's business lines, but what you are cutting is my Qiyan tribe's war horse, and what you are drawing is the blood of brothers from the Daru tribe and the Black Forest tribe! Do you think that everyone is blind?"

"Shut up, my envoy!"

Suddenly Dudu shouted loudly and strode into the center of the hall.

"A group of savages digging tree holes in the forest! Do they deserve the reward and punishment of criticizing the Great Khan?!"

Hudu stepped hard on the floor with his leather boots and said arrogantly:

"I'm not afraid to tell you! No matter whether Mo Duntou gets the benefits of the Khan today or not, the items on the tribute list won't matter if there is not even a single hair missing!"

All the Shiwei officials in the palace were shocked into silence by these outrageous words.

Suddenly Dudu turned to Chen Zui and said with a ferocious smile:

"And you are a trickster from the Southern Dynasties! I just saw it outside the palace gate. Your scoundrel dared to show off on Prince Temur's horse! You are really going to have the end of your life today by showing off your cleverness in front of my envoy!"

Suddenly they all stepped forward and approached the king's steps, raised their heads and shouted at Meng Wu:

"Lord of the Mengwu Kingdom! Leaders! The horse being ridden by the Ning Dynasty guard outside the palace is Prince Temur's lost Xueli Qing! These thieves from the Southern Dynasties stole the Sirius war horse, and they are guilty of an unforgivable crime! Prince Temur is trying to skin them and cramp them!"

Suddenly he pointed at the tip of Chen Zui's nose: "Send someone immediately, take off this man's armor and tie him up together with the Ning army outside the palace! This envoy will take them, the third prince's beloved horse, and Sui Gong back to the grassland to return to the Great Khan!"

Meng Wu pressed his hands on the armrest: "Messenger from Hudu, my wife, Wei, has never interfered in the hundreds of years of war between Tianlang and the Ning Dynasty.

This Mr. Chen is an aide under Zhou Qianhu's account in Yunzhou.When he came to Ermu City this time, he brought some products from the Central Plains to discuss business with us, and it had nothing to do with military defense.The envoy wanted to take someone like this, and it was really difficult for Shi Wei to comply."
